description.value:
Tags wild, apex

Frame + Dermal + Viscera + Circulatory. A torso-wide symbiotic organism laced through your core that shares the body with you. +2 apex item bonus to Constitution (to 22). Fast healing 5. Resistance 5 to physical damage and 5 to poison. Once per round it takes a single 1-action Interact or a Strike with its own limb (1d10 bludgeoning, reach 10 feet) that costs you no action.

Rider: It is a person now, more or less. It has one standing want — a food, a place, a grudge, the GM's to set — and if it goes ignored too long it will spend your body chasing it. At Resonance 9 you and the GM renegotiate who is driving.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 apex item bonus to Constitution has no confirmed hook, same finding as Chimera-Bloom/Ogre-Arm (apex items only ever grant a skill FlatModifier tied to an ability, never the raw score). The free once-per-round Interact/Strike the symbiote takes on its own, and the standing-want/Resonance-9 renegotiation rider, both have no hook: nothing grants a second creature's-worth of actions for free, and the rider is narrative GM adjudication.
